sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Process Automation Solutions design and implement digital workflows and automation technologies to streamline manual or repetitive tasks. It defines automation scope, business rules, integration points, and technology requirements. Following the ACE model and 6D methodology, it ensures automation aligns with business goals and delivers measurable efficiency gains.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Drives productivity and accuracy by reducing human error, cycle time, and operational costs. It frees employees for higher-value work, accelerates process execution, and supports scalable digital transformation initiatives.
